episode_title: AI Reveals Competitor Content Strategies in Minutes with Chris Long

real_qa.q: What percentage of B2B CMOs use LLMs as their primary discovery method versus Google Search as a verification layer?
real_qa.r: A CMO report found that most B2B CMOs are now starting their search on an LLM, with 73% of them using Google Search as a verification layer, not a discovery layer. CMOs are looking for companies and then using Google to find red flags, so Google serves almost as a reputation management source.
real_qa.requete: B2B CMOs LLM Google Search verification layer percentage

real_qa.q: What investment shift are B2B CMOs planning for AEO and GEO in 2026 compared to 2025?
real_qa.r: CMOs went from 0% investment in AEO/GEO in 2025 to 36% saying they would invest in that channel in 2026. It was actually the second biggest investment channel right under AI and automation tooling. Many CMOs view it as a separate investment category from traditional SEO rather than a shift of existing SEO budgets.

real_qa.q: How does WebMCP help AI agents interact more precisely with website forms and e-commerce features?
real_qa.r: Google released WebMCP as structured data for websites, allowing sites to mark up their pages using APIs so that when Google adds agent features, agents know exactly where to click to submit forms, create reservations, add to carts, or complete checkouts. Without WebMCP, agents rely on HTML and are okay but not great at these actions; WebMCP makes them much more precise in interfacing with sites.
real_qa.requete: WebMCP Google agents form fills add to cart checkout

guest.bio_context: Chris Long spent years in SEO at GoFish Digital, where the SEO division had roughly 80 to 100 people when he was there. He has deep expertise in SEO, AEO, and GEO. He co-founded Nective with Jason Melman, a full-stack developer who previously built SEOworkflows.com, a platform for content engineering workflows. At Nective, they focus on building automation tools for briefing, page refreshing, internal linking, and AI-powered competitive analysis rather than defaulting to hiring.
